en: Sepia-toned vintage street view of a small European town. The scene shows a gently curving road lined with two‑ and three‑story houses and shops. On the right side a shop sign reads "Max Gössel" and the buildings have arched doorways and shuttered windows. On the left side is an older house with a wooden fence and a small garden area. In the distance, higher on a hill, stands a large building with a dome or tower. Printed text at the top right reads "Frauenstein i. Erzgeb."
